# Ipanema.com

> > Comprehensive insider's guide to Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, covering travel planning, shopping, dining, nightlife, and tourist attractions.

Ipanema.com serves as a complete travel resource for visitors to Rio de Janeiro and other Brazilian destinations including Buzios, Salvador, and Foz do Iguassu. The site provides practical information, itineraries, hotel booking assistance, and local expertise for exploring Rio's neighborhoods, beaches, landmarks like Corcovado and Sugarloaf, and cultural experiences.

## Key Topics

- Rio de Janeiro
- Brazil tourism
- Travel planning and itineraries
- Corcovado and Sugarloaf
- Shopping and services
- Restaurants and nightlife
- Hotel booking
- Tourist attractions
- Day trips (Buzios, Petropolis)
- Brazilian destinations (Salvador, Florianopolis, Foz do Iguassu)
- City neighborhoods (Ipanema, Copacabana)
- Beaches and outdoor activities
- Museums and cultural sites
- Practical travel information
- Guided tours

## Travel Planning & Guides

- [Rio de Janeiro Travel Planner - Insider's Guide](https://ipanema.com/travel/): Rio de Janeiro travel planner with itineraries and hotel booking
- [Rio de Janeiro for Beginners - Useful & Practical Information](https://ipanema.com/rio/basics/e/): Beginner's guide with practical information for Rio de Janeiro visitors
- [Rainy Day Activities - Guided Tours & Travel Services](https://ipanema.com/travel/rainy.htm): Rainy day activities guide: museums, malls & indoor tours in Rio

## Shopping & Services

- [Shopping and Services in Rio de Janeiro](https://ipanema.com/shopping/): Shopping guide for Rio de Janeiro featuring boutiques, gems & jewelry
- [Rio Malls & Department Stores](https://ipanema.com/shopping/malls.htm): Rio de Janeiro malls and department stores shopping directory
